name: Nigerian Coconut Rice
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 tbsp coconut oil or vegetable oil

steps: Rinse the rice and leave it to drain well.
Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add 2 tbsp coconut oil, then the diced onions. Cook, stirring, until softened slightly (about 2 minutes).
Stir in the thyme, ginger, and garlic. Cook for a few seconds.
Blend the pepper roughly then add spices and seasoning, salt stir for few minutes, then add fish and chicken
Stir in the rice and fry for about about 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, broth, bay leaf then stir
Cover and cook till firm to bite, about 15 minutes. Or more
When ready you can serve like that or any desired way.
